rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: Decree No. 99.167 of 13 March 1990, issued by the President of the Republic under Article 84(IV) to regulate Law No. 7.976 of 1989 on the federal refinancing of state and municipal external debt, is dated Brasília 13 March 1990 and signed José Sarney (countersigned Mailson Ferreira da Nóbrega); the page notes publication in the DOU of 14 March 1990.
